units.source_text: 姑娘正好坐在斜对面，岛村本是可以直接看到她的，

en.t: The girl was sitting diagonally opposite him, and Shimamura could have looked straight at her,

units.source_text: 可是他们刚上车时，她那种迷人的美，使他感到吃惊，不由得垂下了目光。

en.t: but when they had just boarded the train, her captivating beauty startled him, and he instinctively lowered his eyes.

units.source_text: 就在这一瞬间，岛村看见那个男人蜡黄的手紧紧攥住姑娘的手，

en.t: At that very moment, Shimamura saw the man's wax-yellow hand gripping the girl's hand tightly,

units.source_text: 也就不好意思再向对面望去了。

en.t: and after that he felt too awkward to look across at them again.
